failure.en: Thin authored rings protruded as shelves from the segmented host.
failure.zh: 人工细环像搁板一样突出于分割宿主表面。

cause.en: Generic ring placement ignored local tube shape and direction.
cause.zh: 通用环布置未贴合局部管道形状与方向。

fix.en: Preserved source host; projected low-profile illustrative C-bands onto host-local sections.
fix.zh: 保留源宿主，将低起伏 C 形示意带投影到宿主局部截面。

retest.en: Matched front/back/side comparison; independent exact GLB side/back renders; host vertices/faces unchanged; byte-identical rebuild.
retest.zh: 同相机正后侧对比；独立重导入精确 GLB 的侧面与后面渲染；宿主顶点/面未变；重建输出字节一致。

lesson.en: Repair the authored defect without replacing coherent source anatomy; keep whole-asset limitations explicit.
lesson.zh: 针对人工添加缺陷修复，不替换一致的源解剖；明确保留整体资产限制。

limitations: Illustrative bands, not patient cartilage segmentation; dimensions/count/spacing are authored.
